Method of Attack: Hijacking the Windows Update process to perform OS downgrades
Replacing verified security catalog files with malicious versions
Downgrading ci.dll to an unpatched version
Impacted Systems: Windows systems with Driver Signature Enforcement (DSE)
Attack Vector: Exploiting race conditions in the Windows Update process
Turning off Virtualization-Based Security (VBS) via registry tampering
Indicators of Compromise: tampered registry keys EnableVirtualizationBasedSecurity and RequirePlatformSecurityFeatures
